description.value: Yuji's from Japan is a small, chef-driven Japanese restaurant in Vancouver's Kitsilano neighbourhood, where owner-chef Yuji trained under the traditional Japanese apprenticeship system in Yokohama before bringing his skills to BC. The menu centres on fresh sushi and sashimi made with fish imported directly from Japan, alongside traditional Japanese dishes. A premium Omakase experience is available with three days' advance notice.
